machine.description: Pulsed 30W fiber laser marking and serialization system for inscribing high-contrast 2D DataMatrix barcodes, human-readable alphanumeric text, and lot codes onto molded package surfaces.
machine.manufacturingProcess: A 1064nm pulsed MOPA fiber laser delivers focused beam pulses through a dual-axis galvanometer scanner head and telecentric F-theta lens, vaporizing top epoxy resin monolayers without compromising package internal integrity.
subsystems: 30W Pulsed MOPA Fiber Laser Source (1064 nm)
Fume Extraction Duct & Dual HEPA Filter Manifold

components.name: MOPA Fiber Laser Source
components.importantParameters: Average power (W), pulse frequency (kHz), diode pump current (A).
components.degradationIndicators: Laser power degradation (<26W), pulse shape instability.

components.name: Galvo Scanner Mirrors
components.function: Steers laser beam in X/Y axes at velocities up to 8,000 mm/s.
components.importantParameters: Galvo motor temp (°C), position feedback error (µrad).
components.degradationIndicators: Galvo temp rise (>35°C), barcode edge distortion.

components.name: F-Theta Scan Lens
components.function: Focuses laser beam into flat focal plane across entire package strip.
components.degradationIndicators: Epoxy fume residue on lens, beam spot widening.

sensors.name: Fiber Laser Power
sensors.purpose: Measures optical output power delivered by fiber laser.

sensors.name: Galvo Head Temp
sensors.purpose: Measures galvanometer scanner servo motor temperature.

sensors.name: Exhaust Air Velocity
sensors.purpose: Measures fume extraction air velocity at marking nozzle.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: F-theta lens cleaned every 500 hours, exhaust filter checked weekly

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Optical window cleaning & 2D DataMatrix OCR calibration
maintenance.procedureSummary: Wipe lens with spectroscopic-grade methanol, verify barcode grade A on ISO/IEC 15415 standard.

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Fiber pump laser diode emission decay
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes shallow marks and OCR verification failures
